title: June Diane Raphael Is Not Going to Choose Between Feminine and Funny
summary: "I used to feel like I couldn't do improv because I didn't know enough 'Star Wars' references and I didn't want to wear sneakers onstage," says the 'Elle' star, who opened up to The Hollywood Reporter about her comedy cohort, being typecast and a new pilot she's developing that promises to be an antidote to AI.
